title: Lipi-Ghor: A Large-Scale, Diarized, Multi-Domain Bengali Speech Corpus and a Scalable Pipeline for Building It
abstract: arXiv:2610.36184v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Bengali, spoken by over 230 million people, remains severely under-resourced in spoken language research. Existing open Bengali ASR corpora are confined to short, read or crowd-sourced speech and lack speaker diarization and long-form audio.   We present Lipi-Ghor, a large-scale weakly-supervised Bengali speech corpus comprising 885 hours of audio sourced from 998 YouTube videos across 596 unique channels, spanning 17 diverse domains including audiobooks, drama, religious sermons, news, and regional dialects. Each recording is annotated in SSTT format (Speaker, Speech, Transcription, Timestamp), which combines automated diarization with Bengali YouTube caption tracks.   To our knowledge, Lipi-Ghor is the first Bengali speech corpus to pair large-scale coverage with speaker-diarized, long-form audio annotations, both of which are absent from existing open Bengali resources. We also present the construction methodology as a replicable pipe

translated_title: Lipi-Ghor：一个大规模、带说话人分离标注、多领域的孟加拉语语音语料库及构建它的可扩展流水线
translated_abstract: 孟加拉语拥有超过2.3亿使用者，但在口语语言研究中资源仍严重不足。现有的开源孟加拉语ASR语料库仅限于短篇、朗读式或众包语音，缺乏说话人分离标注和长音频。我们提出了Lipi-Ghor，这是一个大规模弱监督孟加拉语语音语料库，包含885小时的音频，来源于596个不同频道的998个YouTube视频，涵盖有声书、戏剧、宗教布道、新闻和地区方言等17个多样化领域。每个录音均以SSTT格式（说话人、语音、转录、时间戳）进行标注，该格式将自动说话人分离技术与孟加拉语YouTube字幕轨道相结合。据我们所知，Lipi-Ghor是首个将大规模覆盖与说话人分离的长音频标注相结合的孟加拉语语音语料库，而这两者在现有开源孟加拉语资源中均不存在。我们还提出了构建方法，作为一种可复制的流水线。
tldr: 该论文推出了Lipi-Ghor——首个拥有885小时音频、带说话人分离标注的多领域孟加拉语语音语料库，并提供了一套可复制扩展的语料库构建流水线。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Lipi-Ghor, the first large-scale (885-hour), multi-domain Bengali speech corpus with speaker-diarized long-form audio annotations, along with a scalable and replicable pipeline for building such corpora.
